jobs.raw_description:
About:

Are you a high-performing sales professional who thrives in a consultative, mission-driven environment? At Vanguard College Prep, our families invest $3,000 to $15,000+ because our curriculum, elite admissions results, and academic coaching are best-in-class. In this role, you won’t be pushing transactional software or cold-pitching products—you will serve as a respected Enrollment Advisor, guiding ambitious students and parents through one of the most critical journeys of their academic lives while earning an uncapped, performance-driven income.

Compensation:

  • Base Salary:$45,000 - 55,000 / year
  • On-Target Earnings: $70,000–$90,000+
    • Uncapped performance-based commission
  • Comprehensive Benefits:Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO), paid sick days, plus fully paid winter vacations

As an Admissions Sales Consultant, you will be expected to:

1. Enrollment Consultations & Closing

  • Conduct consultative enrollment meetings with prospective students and parents to understand their academic goals, challenges, timelines, and priorities
  • Evaluate each family's needs and confidently recommend the Vanguard program or pathway best suited to the student
  • Clearly communicate Vanguard's methodology, program structure, pricing, expected outcomes, and value
  • Build trust and credibility with families while guiding them through a high-consideration enrollment decision
  • Effectively identify and address questions, concerns, and objections throughout the decision-making process
  • Confidently ask qualified families for their enrollment and guide them through the next steps
  • Achieve monthly enrollment, revenue, and conversion goals through effective consultative selling
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Vanguard's programs, industry trends, and competitor offerings

2. Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Own qualified opportunities from initial contact through enrollment and successful handoff
  • Maintain accurate and detailed CRM records of consultations, communications, follow-ups, next steps, and sales activity
  • Consistently follow up with prospective families who have not yet made an enrollment decision
  • Re-engage qualified leads who previously expressed interest in Vanguard's programs
  • Maintain an organized sales pipeline and proactively move prospective families through each stage of the enrollment process
  • Monitor individual sales performance, conversion rates, pipeline value, and progress toward monthly revenue goals
  • Ensure enrolled families experience a professional and seamless transition from the sales process into onboarding

3. Sales Development & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing and leadership to provide feedback on lead quality, common objections, competitor activity, and prospective family needs
  • Identify referral opportunities and encourage satisfied families to introduce Vanguard to others who may benefit from our programs
  • Support select webinars, informational events, and community outreach initiatives that generate qualified enrollment opportunities
  • Stay informed about changes in standardized testing, college admissions, and the broader college preparation industry

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Sales Experience: 3+ years of consultative sales experience, including demonstrated success closing high-ticket products or services
  • Closing Performance: Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets; candidates should be prepared to discuss prior quotas, close rates, average deal size, and revenue generated
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport with students and parents
  • Consultative Selling: Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, negotiation, and closing skills
  • Work Setup: Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for video consultations
  • Tech Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, CRM platforms such as HubSpot or GoHighLevel, Zoom, and other cloud-based business tools

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to explain educational services offered in a clear and impactful way
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities to be able to meet enrollment goals
  • Experience with meeting revenue goals set by organizations
  • Experience in the college preparation service industry

Why you want to be an Admissions Sales Consultant with Vanguard College Prep:

  • Positioned as an Expert, Not a "Sales Rep": Parents respect your insights, seek your guidance, and value your expertise.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for leadership and long-term career growth
  • Uncapped Earning Potential: Competitive compensation structure that includes commission with benefits
  • Fully Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the autonomy of working from home with regular team collaboration and support.
  • Comprehensive Paid Onboarding: We invest heavily in your success with structured training covering our academic frameworks, objection handling, and consultative sales strategies.

About Vanguard College Prep:

Vanguard College Prep is a premier, results-driven education company serving high-achieving families across the country. Our programs are built for students who want to compete at the highest levels of academic performance — from top SAT/ACT scores to elite college admissions.

Founded on a simple belief — students rise when they are coached with precision, intention, and mastery — Vanguard has grown into one of the most trusted boutique education firms for families seeking real, measurable outcomes.

  • We don’t do cookie-cutter tutoring.
  • We don’t offer generic “test prep packages.”
  • We build transformational academic pathways tailored to each student.
Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 / year
